data.text:
Mohammed Ikbal S/O Ali Mohammad vs State Of Rajasthan 
(2024:Rj-Jp:48000) on 25 November, 2024 
Author: Mahendar Kumar Goyal
Bench: Mahendar Kumar Goyal
[2024:Rj-Jp:48000]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
 S.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 16708/2024
1. Mohammed Ikbal S/o Ali Mohammad, Aged About 52
 Years, R/o Ward No. 08, Mukundgarh Mandi, Mukundgarh 
 (Rural), District- Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. 
2. Mohammad Ajiz S/o Abdul Haq, Aged About 60 Years, R/o 
 Ward No. 08, Mukundgarh Mandi, Mukundgarh (Rural),
 District- Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan . 
3. Japhar S/o Ali Mohammad, Aged About 46 Years, R/o  Ward No. 07, Mukundgarh (Rural), District Jhunjhunu, 
 Rajasthan . 
 ----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through The Secretary, Department  Of Food And Civil Supplies, Government Of Rajasthan, At  Secretariat, Jaipur. 
2. Office Of The District Food Safety And Drugs Controller-  Jhunjhunu, Through The Designated Officer (Food Safety)
 And Chief Medical And Health Officer- Jhunjhunu,
 Rajasthan. 
3. Municipal Board- Mukundgarh, Through The Executive  Officer, District- Jhunjhunu.
4. Anwar, M/s Khatri Meat Shop, At Ward No. 08,
 Mukangarhmandi, Mukangarh (Rural), District Jhunjhunu,
 Rajasthan.
5. Khalid Khatri S/o Gulam Husain, R/o M/s Khatri Meat  Corner, Ward No. 08, Mukundgarh Mandi, District-  Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan). 
6. Mohd. Irfan Khatri S/o Mohd Yasin Khan, R/o M/s Khatri  Meat Shop At Ward No. 08, Mukundgarh Mandi, District-  Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan)
7. Mo. Aslam S/o Gulam Husain, R/o M/s Khatri Meat Shop  At Ward No. 08, Mukundgarh Mandi, District- Jhunjhunu  (Rajasthan).
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. David Mehla with Mr. Dharmendra Singh For Respondent(s) :

1 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MAHENDAR KUMAR GOYAL Judgment / Order 25/11/2024 [2024:RJ-JP:48000] (2 of 2) [CW-16708/2024 ] Learned counsel for the petitioners wants to withdraw this civil writ petition as he has instructions to avail the appropriate remedy available under the law for redressal of their grievance(s). 
The civil writ petition is dismissed accordingly. Pending application(s), if any, also stands disposed of. 
(MAHENDAR KUMAR GOYAL),J Manish/12 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
